text:
The plate holds about 13 golden, rectangular pieces. They look like fried cassava or polenta, or possibly pineapple chunks. The yellow-orange color and slightly crisp edges suggest fried polenta or cassava.

Each piece is roughly 2.5 × 1.5 × 1.5 cm, about 6–8 g, so 13 pieces come to about 90 g. Fried cassava or polenta runs about 2 kcal/g, which gives about 180 kcal.

If the pieces were pineapple, the same mass would be only about 45 kcal. The fried look is the more likely reading, so I'm going with roughly 170 kcal.

{"kcal": 170, "mass_g": 85}
